title: Field-State Vocabulary
description: Standardized states for missingness in the EdgeCrew Math Engine.

field_state.description: Standardized state for missingness or data quality.

MISSING.description: Data is entirely absent. MUST NOT be assigned a default value.

PROXY.description: Data is approximated using a proxy (e.g., historical average).

STALE.description: Data is outdated but still usable for limited purposes.

UNAVAILABLE.description: Data cannot be retrieved due to external constraints.

CONFLICTED.description: Multiple conflicting sources exist for the same data point.
